name: Da Lat Cathedral
summary: The cathedral on Tran Phu is the pink church with the rooster on the bell tower, completed in 1942. The outside look takes about 20 minutes and Visit Lâm Đồng lists the exterior as free. Interior hours are Check on arrival. It is not Domaine de Marie.
getThere: Walk from Xuan Huong Lake to Tran Phu
heroCaption: The cathedral and its bell tower

notice.title: This is not Domaine de Marie
notice.body: The rooster tower is the cathedral on Tran Phu. Domaine de Marie is the pink convent church at 1 Ngo Quyen, a separate stop.

body: Stand on Tran Phu for the pink facade and the rooster on the bell tower. Visit Lâm Đồng and Vietnam Tourism put the completion in 1942. Morning light falls on the front. Twenty minutes is enough outside.
Do not mix this church with Domaine de Marie on Ngo Quyen. That convent is a different building. Interior hours here are Check on arrival. The published visit is the exterior.

figures.caption: The bell tower from below
figures.alt: Looking up at the bell tower of Da Lat Cathedral

gettingThere: The cathedral is on Tran Phu, a walk from Xuan Huong Lake. A door number and a walking minute count are not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Walk to Tran Phu. Minutes are Check on arrival.

admissionNote: Exterior viewing is free on Visit Lâm Đồng summaries. Interior hours are Check on arrival. No interior fee is printed.
